notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - 4 NEW GAME MODES!
notes.notes:
Dear Sandboxers

After a long period, we are out of our hibernation and excited to bring a MAJOR update to The Sandbox Evolution on Steam, including

Here are all the details about this update:

Sandmix Update
Miner Mode
Monsters Frenzy
Swipe Knight
Deep Space 


We've been working hard on this one to bring a lot of new contents all at once, as well as many bugs fixes and stability improvements!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/466940/The_Sandbox_Evolution__Craft_a_2D_Pixel_Universe/

Keep sending us all your suggestions - tell us how we can make the game more awesome for you! 

http://steamcommunity.com/app/466940/discussions/0/215439774856637116/

Hope you’ll enjoy playing it!
The Sandbox Team


Changelog

DEEP SPACE UPDATE
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26305641/b1a04a8b9f6dc4fb8e655342cf6f4df7ba3faf00.png

TIME TO REACH NEW HORIZONS! TRAVEL TO DEEP SPACE AND CREATE ALIEN WORLDS.

Add low Gravity to any world. Elements fall slower, jumps become higher!
Meet the Astronaut. A new controllable hero eager to make new discoveries. 
New Vehicle: the Lander can help you travel to new frontiers.
New elements to create alien landscapes: Carbonium and Moon Rock.
New Enemies! Populate your space worlds with these 3 aliens:

Jumper. Jumps around and sticks to any surface.
Digger. Eats Moon Rock.
Father. He spawns other aliens.

Many decorations to bring life to your extraterrestrial settings.


SWIPE KNIGHT MODE
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26305641/4d2106dda798d82c367f5b6b4c803cf189a23805.png
Create your own Dungeon-Crawler game with this new update!
Ready to explore dungeons full of traps & enemies?

1 new Hero: Swipe Knight, a top-down character who can be upgraded
5 Enemies: Goblin, Shield Goblin, Crossbow Goblin, Miner Goblin and Snake.
4 Spirits: they patrol specific areas and affect your status: Confusion, Ice, Fire, Acid
2 new Hazards: Rotoblade and ElectroCoil.
And more: Jump Pad, Moving Platforms, Redirector, Teleportal, Destroyable Vase, Knight Coins.





MONSTERS FRENZY
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26305641/786624a9dd7a11c5f3b7b1bc4b5c81b312b8c069.png
Monster Frenzy Update! Smash whole cities and fight the army with giant controllable Monsters Creatures!
Destroy all buildings in a level to win!!

2 new Giant Monsters with immense strength: 

The Cyclops and his special Mystic Eyeblast attack
The Carcinos and his special Crab Typhoon attack


6 Building Segments: make your own skyscrapers by stacking these buildings on top of each other.
Each has a different power: Rifle Soldier (Attack), Restaurant (Heal), Bouncy (Jump) and Explosive (Explode)

5 new Military Troops and an indestructible Base that spawns them: Fighter Jets, Rifle Soldiers, Homing Rocket Soldiers, Tanks and Helicopters!


MINER MODE
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26305641/10ca22fc388a7299ffb0a4710335ed45dea59fab.png
CREATE your own Mining Game! Design the mine layout, add traps and precious ores, then place the Exit. Try it yourself then when ready share it to the Online Gallery!
 
PLAY mining levels made by other players! Control the Miner Hero by swiping, upgrade your Pickaxe and win as many levels as you can to rank in the Leaderboards!   

Discover the new Miner elements:

15 different rocks to break
4 Pickaxes upgrades available by combining 3 Ores collected in the mine (Iron, Gold and Diamond) 
4 special Hazards & Traps
Many more elements: Miner Sign, Color Switches, Color Arrow Traps and Color Doors (in 6 colors), etc.
3 Xmas Elements: The Grouch, the Xmas Bell Tower and the Xmas Gift.



SANDMIX UPDATE
The Sandmix update is here, featuring a collection of new Elements from the most popular thematics of The Sandbox Evolution!

Over 20 elements to discover in this Sandmix update:

Potassium, Blizzard, Sailboat, Bad Brainiac
More Humans from different nations and ethnicities.
Shield and Speed Power-Ups for all controllable Heroes! (Originally only for Runner)
Create stunning chiptune melodies with 2 new instruments: the Drums and the Flute
Draw amazing pixel art with 3 new colour palettes
Loved our PAC-MAN update? 1 new Ghost and 1 new Power-up will spice up your mazes!
A couple of new Decorations!

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE ❤️🔥🎉
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26305641/8ed6b4a48a6be2642f60079d0f9197fce2ef2b99.png

Dear Sandboxers

We've been working hard on this one to bring a lot of new contents all at once, as well as many bugs fixes and stability improvements!


Changelog
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26305641/6dae535b2d447a85e746e0f8ece4774aba0d0116.png
ENEMIES & HAZARDS
11 new hazards and 6 new enemies! 
Enhance your creations with these unique traps and bring more challenges hardcore challenge for players who adventure into your levels!






Stalactite: This hanging metallic stake will fall when a Character moves beneath it.
Aqualing: This "Fluidling" floats on Water and jumps upwards until it reaches its original spawning point.
Toxling: This "Fluidling" floats on Acid and jumps upwards until it reaches its original spawning point.
Acid Bar: This Rotating Bar melts Characters on touch. You can set its length and rotation by Pressing and Holding on the axis.
Fire Bar: This Rotating Bar burns Characters on touch. You can set its length and rotation by Pressing and Holding on the axis.
Crash Bar: This Rotating Bar bumps Characters on touch. You can set its length and rotation by Pressing and Holding on the axis.
Boomba: An explosive version of the Doomba, it runs towards its targets and explodes shortly after.
SpikeDoomba: A Doomba that made a helmet out of a broken SpikeBall. It cannot be stomped.
Hanging Rock: This dangerous spiked block will fall when a Character moves beneath it.
Bumper: The Bumper will make certain elements bounce off it. It can be Rotated by tapping on it.
Wind Blower: The Blower pushes certain things forward. Can be Rotated by tapping and intensity can be modified by Pressing and Holding.
Wind Vacuum: The Vacuum pushes certain things forward. Can be Rotated by tapping and intensity can be modified by Pressing and Holding.
Explosive Barrel: A rolling Barrel that bounces while moving and will explode on contact with a target.
Spiked Barrel: A rolling Barrel full of spikes that will damage any Character that gets in its way.
RotoTurret: A floating, omnidirectional Turret that will shoot at Characters when they approach.
Hoopba: A jumping Doomba. It's fused with a spring so it moves by jumping.
Hidden Spike: This trap thrusts a Spike towards anything that gets in its activation area. Can be Rotated by tapping on it.


 HALLOWEEN!
Start crafting spooky pixel universes and make your own horrific game levels with tons of monstrous elements.

Over 16 scary Elements: Demon Slayer, Headless Horseman, Necromancer, Goostba, Vampire, Mummy, Black Cat, Rat and more!
Halloween-themed decorations: Jack O' Lantern, Scary Skeletons, Haunted Trees, Haunted Manor, etc.
Spooky Backgrounds.
New Pixel Art colour palette.

Changelog
DINOSAURS
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26305641/b4ec5043b54e53007e836c8999f2761c5d113766.png
This update brings dinosaurs to the game! Add giant prehistoric creatures to your worlds and see them thrive in your environments 6 new dinosaurs to play with:

Triceratops: This large-sized triple horned herbivore can defend itself when in danger.
Velociraptor: A fast and ferocious predator, the Velociraptor spreads out to seek prey and regroups to hunt it down.
Pachycephalosaurus: His hard, round head allows him to charge and damage enemies that threaten his life. Nimble and with well developed legs, he’s fast. 
Spinosaurus: The largest carnivorous dinosaur has 2 attacks (short and long range), and damages entities and particles while moving. It’s very hard to survive an attack of this apex predator.
Brachiosaurus: Pacific in nature, this gigantic herbivore panics when attacked (or when a carnivore comes too close) and attempts to stomp them.
Compsognathus: This very small but dangerous carnivore, swarms its prey with the strength of numbers.


SKINS! 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26305641/a10f94f3be4268db8898f3c61f5add825542f29d.png

Choose which Hero you want to be!
Play inside any user-made level and choose among 27 new skins for our 3 most popular heroes: Arnold, Avatar and Brainiac. Do you want to be a Hitman, a Rambo, a Terminator, a Disco Dancer, a Pumpkin Head, a Lizard, a Zombie, a Rapper or a Diva?


 ECOLOGY 2!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26305641/eeab3112e5d2b2f1624160ae316ee698386a93aa.png
Did you enjoy playing with Lighting, Earthquake, Tornado or the Nuke?
This update adds 8 new exciting Natural Disasters or elements that cause them. Bring destruction and show you are a god with no mercy on your universes!!

Geyser: It absorbs Liquids anywhere below and generates a burst of Gases. Try placing it above Oil and Acid!
Fire Whirl: A raging Fire Tornado that burns and destroys everything in its path.
Tsunami: A tidal wave that will pass through the whole level, from left to right, destroying anything in its path!
Acid Tsunami: This Tsunami is even worse than the normal one. A giant wave of corrosive Acid!
Lava Tsunami: A scorching surge of molten Lava. Instantly destroys organic particles like Mud or Wood.
Smog: If too much of this polluting smoke reaches the atmosphere, everyone will start to suffocate. Use Trees to reduce the smog levels.
Acid Steam: A gas with the same destructive properties as Acid. Can trigger Acid rain if too much of it reaches the atmosphere.
Rainbow: This light phenomenon will become more visible in the presence of Rain.

http://www.thesandboxgame.com/gif/TSBEvolution%20-%20Skin%20Dino.gif

http://www.thesandboxgame.com/gif/TSBEvolution%20-%20Firewhirl%20Preview.gif

notes.title: 6 Vehicles + Brainiac Update - Craft ⛏️ ⚙️ 🕹️
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26305641/e8fb5d1f9fc6d2ac95ba72de44c5e72e9df59a7e.png

Meet the Brainiac! Craft dynamic contraptions, use it with our interactive blueprints

DRIVERS, START YOUR ENGINES! Drive 6 new Vehicles with your favorite heroes behind the wheel.
Let's go for a spin in a Tank, Helicopter, BattleMech, Submarine, Reaptire or the Bathysphere. 
These new vehicles will expand the gameplay for every character you use with them!

http://www.thesandboxgame.com/gif/TSBEvolution%20-%20Vehicles%20Preview.gif

http://www.thesandboxgame.com/gif/TSBEvolution%20-%20Brainiac%20Animation.gif


This version 1.3.1 brings several improvements and fixes to the game

Changelog
CRAFT DYNAMIC CONTRAPTIONS

Create very advanced contraptions that player can move to fit into several bodies such as Tortodrone, Spaceship, Deathbomber, Megadrill
Make your own multi-pixels combination with existing elements and assemble them, move them, transport materials or activate separate actions
7 new Textures available to make your Brainiac-controlled structures with
2 new campaigns will guide you through the inner working of the Brainiac and let you craft amazing stuff!

6 NEW VEHICLES: A NEW TYPE OF CONTROLLABLE ENTITY

Tank: This mighty war machine can shoot explosive shells to obliterate your enemies.
BattleMech: A powerful, rocket-propelled humanoid vehicle that can hover and blast electricity to kill enemies and electrify Metal wires.
Attack Helicopter: Armed with a machine gun and missiles, this small helicopter is a force of destruction!
Submarine: This vehicle can submerge and shoot torpedoes to deal with any foes you encounter underwater.
Reaptire: The Reaptire is a big, spiked wheel of destruction turned into a vehicle. It can climb any surface by moving towards it and explodes spectacularly on death!
Hazard Bathysphere: Less mobile than the Submarine, but resistant to Acid and Lava, this Bathysphere is used in hazardous environments.




We hope you will have lots of fun with the game!


http://www.thesandboxgame.com/gif/TSBEvolution%20-%20Brainiac%20Spaceship.gif

http://www.thesandboxgame.com/gif/TSBEvolution%20-%20Tanks%20vs%20Zombies.gif

http://www.thesandboxgame.com/gif/TSBEvolution%20-%20Mecha%20Preview.gif

Thanks for reporting these to us via BugSplat so we can keep hunting them down! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/466940

You can also send us all your suggestions - tell us how we can make the game more awesome for you! http://steamcommunity.com/app/466940/discussions/0/215439774856637116/

Add a Shrektastic touch to your pixel universes with the official new Shrek DLC featuring 19 exclusive new elements. 
Shrek elements can be mixed and matched with all The Sandbox Evolution elements for incredible new levels you can share in the online Gallery -- the only limit is your imagination!


http://www.thesandboxgame.com/gif/TSBEvolution%20-%20Shrek_2.gif

This version 1.1.8 brings several improvements and fixes to the game

Exit Hatch: This victory condition allows you to make interesting and unique levels. 
Teleporter: These awesome portals let any entity go through to anywhere you want! 
U.F.O: This spaceship is no joke; its tractor beam will drag any unit upward and make it disappear!. 
Speaker: This giant speaker gets the party started, making your humans dance to techno music! 
Elevator: This elevator will make your constructions look even cooler--no more plain old stairs!
